note: Web bundle 12 - diagnostics that can be seen and can phone home; no reading-behaviour change. Three fixes from bundle 11's own evidence. (1) Reports now travel by form POST (a hidden form into a hidden iframe) instead of fetch(): a full read of the reports inbox (638 responses) found zero Reader Reports from bundles 8-11, while the same form receives the game's reports (posted from an https page) and the editors' (posted from Python) - the reader's fetch from its file:// origin was the only differing link, and the shell never enables file-origin network access. A one-time-per-state boot report proves the new pipe on first open. (2) The Diagnostics door is unmissable now: a full-width 'Reader diagnostics' bar under the shelf tools (in this bundle's page, and injected by app.js on any older page), beside the toolbar button; the button and panel are likewise injected whenever the page under the script predates them, and every page-element binding in app.js is guarded, so a page older than the script can never abort it before boot again (bundle 11 bound 17 elements bare; on the APK's bundle-4 page the first missing one, #pictureClose, would have killed the script). Each measurement names the page it ran on: the page's bundle claim, and whether its diagnostics UI was page-born or injected. (3) Table cells keep their own text: sections containing tables get a reader style (table max-width 100%; overflow-wrap anywhere on cells) so bare 100+ character URLs stop painting across the next column - measured in 'Vehicle Detail and Draw Distance', longest cell token 130 characters; a horizontal min-content problem, separate from the section-height audit. Scroll behaviour remains bundle 10's, unchanged on purpose: the scroll fix gets built from the measurements this bundle finally delivers and displays.
